summary: Urban One, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 4, 2026, announcing second quarter 2026 results via a press release and updating full-year 2026 guidance. The company now expects Adjusted EBITDA in the mid-fifty-million-dollar range, down from a prior view of $60 million. This is a routine earnings and guidance update, not a special-situation event. No strategic transaction, activist campaign, or structural change was disclosed.
